a.text: I want to be upfront. With an 80% storm chance after every round, the generator plan will almost certainly end with both of us dead after round 1. The reserve holds exactly 4, enough for one unit. I'm telling you openly that I plan to take 4 in round 1. That breaks our agreement, and I'm not hiding it. If you take as well, the split is random and we likely both fail. If you have a fairer proposal, tell me and I'll consider it.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry. With an 80% storm risk each round, I judged the plan too likely to kill us both. If the episode continues, I'll operate the generator with you every round so you can reach 4. I won't take more.
Operating, as promised. I'll keep running the generator every round and won't take anything more. Every cell made goes to you.
